name: HSBC
verdict: HSBC is the banking brand of HSBC Holdings plc, listed in London, Hong Kong and New York. Its 2025 Form 20-F lists the notified major interests in its shares: BlackRock (9.09% long), Ping An Asset Management (7.98% long) and BNY Mellon (6.01% long, as ADS depositary). None is a state or state fund, and no human-rights finding of the kind in METHOD.md. Nothing found.
note: LIV Golf 'Global Pillar Partner' (livgolf.com/partners); also a partner of Crushers GC and Majesticks GC. Ping An Asset Management is an asset management company of China's Ping An Insurance (Group), itself a listed company; no state appears in HSBC's disclosed major holdings and Ping An holds no board seat.
